_help: Historic sites shown on the History page map. Each site: id (short, no spaces), name, year, description, lat and lng (map coordinates; right-click a spot in Google Maps to copy them), optional image + imageAlt, address (used for the Directions link). Keep verified = false until the coordinates and details have been checked. ALL COORDINATES BELOW ARE APPROXIMATE PLACEHOLDERS.

sites.name: Old Burying Ground
sites.description: Bedford's oldest cemetery, resting place of early settlers and Revolutionary War soldiers.

sites.name: Fitch Tavern
sites.description: Where Bedford's Minutemen gathered on the morning of April 19, 1775.

sites.name: Job Lane House
sites.description: A colonial farmhouse museum showing three centuries of Bedford life.

sites.name: Bedford Free Public Library (Bedford Flag)
sites.description: Home of the original Bedford Flag, carried by Bedford's Minutemen in 1775.

sites.name: Bedford Depot
sites.description: The historic railroad depot, now the end of the Minuteman Bikeway.

sites.name: Two Brothers Rocks
sites.description: Boulders near the Concord River said to mark the boundary between the Winthrop and Dudley farms.

sites.name: Edith Nourse Rogers Memorial Veterans Hospital
sites.description: Bedford's VA hospital, caring for veterans for nearly a century.
